name: Forbidden Knowledge
objectiveText: Bring Yagyin's Digest to Theldurin. Yagyin's Digest (Provided)  ( 1 )

comments.body:
Once upon a time, this item did a fixed amount of damage, instead of a percent-based amount of damage, while still offering a 60% speed increase.  At that time, it was considered a "must-have" pvp item, both for the run speed and for the ability to break various forms of CC.  Since the change to do a percent-based health and mana reduction, it is less desirable.

Its primary use now is to keep around and use to try and kill yourself to save durability rather than be killed by NPCs in a raid wipe.
